title: Ecoasis Exploration
description: A Fabric modpack for those who love to explore nature and test their creativity!
body:
## ✯ Notice | !!
The current state of this mod is very much a concept (*Alpha versions*). The composition of mods and their configs will be changed over time as I have time.

***Join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/YkG2FEU6QT) for more frequent updates and to send any suggestions you may have.***

## ✯ Description | (WIP)
**Ecoasis** aims to encourage players to explore, plan, and build to their imagination's extent! Upon full release, it will be a cohesive compilation of various world generation, structure, block, and item mods that stick close to nature in the overworld while other dimensions dive inot fantasy.

*There is also a plan for a future resource pack that would be compatible with all the mods.


## ✯ Featured Mods & Datapacks | (WIP)
- Items will frequently be added or removed while in Alpha testing.
